protocol.samples: Reuse exact 32 saved two-day training resamples in each fold, no resampling search
protocol.boundary: Inverse expected day multiplicity under original sampler; normalize weighted loss per member
protocol.scaler: For shared variants use full training fold mean/std, never evaluation data
protocol.constants: Unchanged L2 .1, coefficient bounds +/-.25, feature set, costs, risk and .04 threshold
protocol.limits: Development-only 2x2 mechanism audit, no holdout access, automatic promotion or claim of independent confirmation
